name: ParityQC
description: ParityQC is an Austrian quantum software company developing quantum computing architecture optimization and compiler technology. The company provides ParityOS, a blueprint for quantum computers optimized for solving optimization problems, and works with hardware providers to improve quantum system performance.

products.name: ParityOS
products.description: Quantum architecture operating system that provides hardware-optimized blueprints for solving optimization problems

highlights: ParityOS provides a unique architecture blueprint optimized specifically for optimization workloads
Works directly with quantum hardware providers to co-design more efficient quantum processors
Spin-off from University of Innsbruck with EUR 10M+ in funding

news.title: Classiq and ParityQC Partner to Optimize and Streamline Quantum Execution
news.excerpt: Classiq and ParityQC announced a partnership to integrate ParityQC's Parity Twine technology with Classiq's quantum software engineering platform to improve quantum program execution on hardware with limited qubit connectivity.

news.title: ParityQC: a blueprint for Europe's quantum future
news.excerpt: ParityQC positions itself as a key player in Europe's quantum computing future with its architecture blueprint and operating system.

news.title: YZ-plane measurement-based quantum computation: Universality and Parity Architecture implementation
news.excerpt: Peer-reviewed paper demonstrating universal quantum computation driven by YZ-plane measurements and embedding into the ParityQC Architecture with register-logic graphs.

news.title: QUDORA and ParityQC partner to optimise quantum algorithms for trapped-ion systems
news.excerpt: Partnership combines QUDORA's Near-Field Quantum Control with ParityQC's Parity Twine architecture to reduce gate counts on ion-trap hardware.

news.title: ParityQC demonstrates 52-qubit quantum Fourier transform on IBM Heron
news.excerpt: Parity Twine architecture nearly doubles the previous 27-qubit QFT record and shows exponential scaling advantage on IBM superconducting hardware.

news.title: ParityQC demonstrates universal quantum computation via YZ-plane measurements, removing long-range connectivity requirements
news.excerpt: Researchers show YZ-plane measurements alone achieve universal MBQC and can be embedded in ParityQC Architecture using only local interactions, reducing physical hardware demands.

news.title: ParityQC and University of Innsbruck propose parity-unfolded distillation architecture cutting FTQC overhead
news.excerpt: The new fault-tolerant scheme, optimised for noise-biased platforms, achieves a 26% reduction in physical qubit footprint and a 43% decrease in logical error rate compared with standard distillation methods, using nearest-neighbour interactions only.

news.title: ParityQC and Classiq Partner to Optimize Quantum Circuit Execution via Parity Twine
news.excerpt: ParityQC and Classiq announced a technology integration combining ParityQC's Parity Twine compilation technology with Classiq's quantum software platform, targeting reduction of circuit complexity and SWAP gate overhead on near-term hardware.
